caption: Average performance of different models on the November 2024 AMC-10 and AMC-12 tests. This is the average score (with maximum score 150) over the four tests on 100 runs with temperature t=0.5. We chose t = 0.5 to follow simple-evals <cit.>. Error bars are 2 of the estimate. On competition math, scores well above its weight-class even compared to non–open-weight models.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average performance of various large and small models on the November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests. The horizontal axis contains the model names, and the vertical axis represents the average score, with a label and a scale ranging from 60 to 90, marked in increments of 10, with no units specified. The chart features two categories of bars, colored light blue for large models and blue for small models, with error bars indicating an estimate of uncertainty. The large model bars have approximate values ranging from 66.4 for Llama-3.3 70B instruct to 89.8 for Gemini Pro 1.5. The small model bars have approximate values ranging from 74.8 for Claude 3.5 Sonnet to 91.8 for phi-4. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the error bars and distinct colors for each model type.
